statement: Some responses are recorded more than once
suggested_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id, campaign_id, response_date, revenue FROM responses GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*) > 1)

statement: Some customers are in both treatment and control of the same campaign
suggested_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id, campaign_id FROM contacts GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(DISTINCT grp) > 1)

statement: Some responses are dated before the customer was contacted
suggested_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM responses r JOIN contacts c USING (customer_id, campaign_id) WHERE r.response_date < c.contact_date

statement: Some campaigns end before they start
suggested_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM campaigns WHERE end_date < start_date
